authorization: Current authenticated administrator session; access is audited; no policy mutation.

fields.implementation: IMPLEMENTED / PARTIAL / NOT_IMPLEMENTED describes source capability, not activation or test execution.
fields.configured: Current validated server policy and metadata; no secret keys, session tokens, raw hardware identifiers or certificates.
fields.verification: NOT_RECORDED unless a manual execution report matches the current REGISTERED manifest, source-manifest SHA-512 and exact A/B/O hashes. Imported values remain OPERATOR_RECORDED, not independently attested CI/build/physical evidence; only listed checks are scoped.
fields.limitations: Known source capability or verification limits.
fields.deviceIdentity: Current mode, policy revision, trust-expiry state and enrollment counts; counts are not a new attestation decision.
fields.tpmUnexpiredEnrollments: Active TPM-labeled enrollment metadata whose attestedUntil is in the future, independent of current trust configuration. Not a current trust or session-validity result.
fields.publication: Current effective new-publication requirements and stored runtime policy are both exposed; reading them never migrates stored policy.
fields.tpmCurrentRootEnrollments: Unexpired active TPM enrollment whose stored rootSha256 matches a currently configured, non-revoked CA certificate within its validity period while the trust policy is unexpired. Does not revalidate a full EK chain, session proof/epoch/policy revision or Windows execution.
fields.tpmCurrentRoots: Count of configured CA certificate fingerprints currently within validity, not root-revoked, and inside trust.validUntil.
fields.persistentKeyRequired: Global all-device requirement only; false in COMPATIBLE does not mean enrolled devices may omit proof.
fields.persistentKeyRequiredForEnrolled: Policy requires proof from enrolled devices when global requirement or requireForEnrolled is enabled; exact legacy-flow grace remains a separate authorization rule.
fields.persistentKeyRequirementScope: ALL_DEVICES / ENROLLED_DEVICES / OPTIONAL describes server policy scope, not current process authorization.
fields.manualVerification: Exact REGISTERED manifest/source/A/B/O build groups; per-check history and evidence-file digests; CURRENT/STALE/UNBOUND configuration binding. Missing checks are NOT_RECORDED; a partial V3 report cannot mark all domains complete.

manualVerification.authorization: Administrator, current session, CSRF, recent reauthentication; audited mutation.
manualVerification.retention: 64 immutable reports; reject new records at capacity, no silent eviction.

lifecycle.authorization: Current administrator session; read access audited. Query filters are strict and bounded.
lifecycle.limits: A/B process exits are child observations. Self exit cannot be reported as observed. Deletion scheduling is not file absence. Missing reports remain unknown.
